%-------------------------
% Resume Template — Justin Mascarenhas
% Based on Jake Gutierrez's resume template (MIT License)
% Source: https://github.com/jakegut/resume
%
% This file contains the preamble and formatters only.
% The body is generated by scripts/generate_pdf.py from tailored JSON.
% Edit this file to change formatting/layout. Do not edit the body manually.
%-------------------------

\documentclass[letterpaper,11pt]{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{latexsym}
\usepackage[empty]{fullpage}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{marvosym}
\usepackage[usenames,dvipsnames]{color}
\usepackage{verbatim}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage[english]{babel}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{tabularx}

% ----- PAGE LAYOUT & MARGINS -----
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyfoot{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

\addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{-0.5in}
\addtolength{\evensidemargin}{-0.5in}
\addtolength{\textwidth}{1.0in}
\addtolength{\topmargin}{-.6in}
\addtolength{\textheight}{1.2in}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedbottom
\raggedright
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0in}

% Section formatting
\titleformat{\section}{
  \vspace{-5pt}\scshape\raggedright\large
}{}{0em}{}[\color{black}\titlerule \vspace{-3pt}]

%=============================================================================
% CUSTOM FORMATTERS
%=============================================================================

\newcommand{\resumeSummary}[1]{
  \small{#1}
  \vspace{-3pt}
}

\newcommand{\resumeSkills}[2]{
  \small{\textbf{#1}{: #2}} \\
}

\newcommand{\resumeExperience}[4]{
  \vspace{-1pt}
  \begin{tabular*}{0.99\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} $|$ \textbf{#2} & \small #3 \\
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-5pt}
  \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.15in, label={$\vcenter{\hbox{\tiny$\bullet$}}$}]
    \setlength{\itemsep}{1.5pt}
    \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
    \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}
    #4
  \end{itemize}
  \vspace{-4pt}
}

\newcommand{\resumeProject}[3]{
  \vspace{-1pt}
  \begin{tabular*}{0.99\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} & \small #2 \\
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-5pt}
  \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.15in, label={$\vcenter{\hbox{\tiny$\bullet$}}$}]
    \setlength{\itemsep}{1.5pt}
    \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
    \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}
    #3
  \end{itemize}
  \vspace{-4pt}
}

\newcommand{\resumeEducation}[4]{
  \vspace{-1pt}
  \begin{tabular*}{0.99\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} $|$ \text{#2} & \small #3 \\
  \end{tabular*}\vspace{-5pt}
  \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0in, label={}]
    \setlength{\itemsep}{1.5pt}
    \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
    \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}
    #4
  \end{itemize}
  \vspace{-2pt}
}

% Use for an education entry with no course list — \resumeEducation requires
% at least one \item in #4; an empty itemize is invalid LaTeX and silently
% collapses the entry's spacing during error recovery.
\newcommand{\resumeEducationHeader}[3]{
  \vspace{-1pt}
  \begin{tabular*}{0.99\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} $|$ \text{#2} & \small #3 \\
  \end{tabular*}
  \vspace{-2pt}
}

\newcommand{\resumeAward}[3]{
  \vspace{-1pt}
  \begin{tabular*}{0.99\textwidth}[t]{l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r}
    \textbf{#1} $-$ \text{#2} & \small #3 \\
  \end{tabular*}
}

\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{
  \item\small{{#1}}
}
